review.note: A9's first step and its second agree here, which is why this record carries an item at all. Q2404547 gives its own `P625` as -10.983333, 26.733333 and its `P276` as Q18780, Likasi — whose own `P625` is the same pair to six places. The point is therefore the town's and not only the battle's, so it is filed under the town's item. The label is the name the town had in 1961; `names` carries both.
